items.title: Lawrence Cotton Interview, 1996-12-10
items.q: I was playing with Edgar Blanchard when Jake Myers left he was a piano player and when Jake left then I went in the band

ctx.x: we played by Gordon A.Tals and we and and Tommy Ridgely would come on on weekends and and play on Sundays they have like continuous music on Sundays and I was playing with Edgar Blanchard when Jake Myers left he was a piano player and when Jake left then I went in the band
Oh Jake was in the band first?
